No, it's critical for the country. I mean, you hate to say this because even though I disagree with him, he's still the president of our country, but I don't know one thing the Biden administration has done right. Respect for the country and for the... for the presidency is that I think is weakest point around the world. You just see weakness projected from the Oval Office, and that's not a good situation. And we're seeing that play out as we speak in Ukraine. So all that's alarming. But I think the biggest concern in many ways is what they're doing to the Constitution, what they're doing to the First Amendment and our liberties. So I think all that together, I'm hopeful it's going to be a good year for us. And we're seeing good signs, what happened in Virginia. Started with a few moms, then it was a few more moms. Pretty soon some dads got involved, and the next thing you know, Glenn Yunken's governor of the Blue State. So, it shows you the power of a mom on a mission. And I think that's going to build. At least I hope it does. We don't want to be overconfident, but we should be confident. We should campaign confidently in our ideas, and hopefully we're going to win.
